verdict.rationale: Shopify Flow powers threshold-based low-stock notifications triggered by sales-rate events, and the pricing page mentions low-code/no-code customization, which points to an event-driven automation layer. Sidekick can also create stock transfers automatically. However, the evidence never shows a general user-authored rule builder covering arbitrary POS events and actions. Missing for 10: documentation of user-defined trigger/condition/action rules for POS events, breadth of supported triggers and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
